notes: Completed two normal combats and reached a Rest Site. Confirmed Snake Plant's Malleable behavior and that a 15-damage multi-hit turn required potion-assisted blocking while Frail was active.
packet.promotion_policy: A lesson changes VEDA only after review, cited or run evidence, an explicit implementation, and a regression test.
proposed_lessons: Proposed: against multi-hit threats while Frail, calculate post-Frail Block before deciding whether to spend a temporary Dexterity potion.

review.feedback: Keep the Frail-versus-multi-hit lesson proposed. Add a survival guardrail: when the projected hit could leave Ironclad below roughly 15-20 HP, prefer guaranteed Block, available potion use, or a safer line over damage unless the line secures a kill. For the next comparable fight, capture before/after screenshots and record enemy intent, hand, energy, Frail, Dexterity, Block, potion availability/use, predicted damage, and actual damage before seeking validation.
